changes.detail: Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 renamed every lifecycle hook to its `on` form and removed setup/cleanup (now onStart/onStop). This package now builds and tests against Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 and requires `elysia ^2.0.0-rc.0`, which also accepts later release candidates and 2.0.0. Its plugin's hooks are renamed to match.

migration.instruction: Upgrade `elysia` and every `@elysia/*` package to 2.0.0-rc.0 or later, then rename lifecycle hooks in your own server: request → onRequest, beforeHandle → onBeforeHandle, afterHandle → onAfterHandle, afterResponse → onAfterResponse, error → onError, parse → onParse, transform → onTransform; setup/cleanup → onStart/onStop. absolutejs/scripts codemods/elysia-rc-hooks.ts does the renames (run it before upgrading Elysia).
